Technical SEO.title: Hackers Hijacked DebugBear's DNS To Serve Malicious JavaScript
Technical SEO.summary: DebugBear's DNS was compromised to deliver malicious JavaScript, prompting the company to advise customers to remove its Core Web Vitals monitoring script. Site owners are also urged to check for exposed accounts and unauthorized changes.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google, Microsoft and OpenAI Plan To Honor Shared AI Training Opt-Out
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A shared robots.txt directive could allow site owners to opt out of AI training across multiple providers simultaneously, though each company involved is handling implementation differently. This has direct implications for enterprise publishers managing content licensing and crawl permissions.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Spam Guide Update, Restaurant Controls and AI Mode Revenue - SEO Pulse
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google updated its spam guide to include indexing guidance for pages made for sharing, alongside separate updates covering restaurant ordering controls and AI Mode revenue signals. The spam guide change is directly relevant to enterprise content teams managing large page sets.

AI Search / GEO.title: Reddit Shares Plunge as Google's AI Search Squeezes Traffic
AI Search / GEO.summary: Reddit's share price fell sharply as Google's AI search features are attributed to squeezing referral traffic to the platform. The story signals broader consequences for publishers and UGC-heavy sites relying on Google organic traffic as AI Overviews expand.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Overviews Nearly Double for Commercial Keywords: Study
AI Search / GEO.summary: A study found Google AI Overviews have nearly doubled their presence on commercial keyword queries, a trend with significant implications for enterprise sites competing in transactional and travel-related search verticals.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Overviews and AI Mode 0.9% Click-Through Rate Says Small Opt-Out Study
AI Search / GEO.summary: A small opt-out study reported a 0.9% click-through rate for Google AI Overviews and AI Mode results, providing a concrete benchmark for teams modeling organic traffic impact from AI answer surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google's AI Opt-Out Leaves Publishers with a Difficult Choice
AI Search / GEO.summary: Digiday reports that Google's AI content opt-out mechanism puts publishers in a difficult position, as exercising the option may carry unintended consequences for their search visibility. This is a critical strategic consideration for enterprise content and legal teams.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Overviews Are Pushing News Boxes Out of Search Results: Study
AI Search / GEO.summary: Research shows Google AI Overviews are displacing News Box placements in search results, reducing a key organic visibility channel for publishers and editorial content teams. Enterprise SEOs managing news or editorial verticals should factor this displacement into SERP feature strategies.

AI Search / GEO.title: Ask HN: Has Google Started Cleaning Their Search Results from AI Slop?
AI Search / GEO.summary: A Hacker News thread questions whether Google has begun taking action against low-quality AI-generated content in search results, reflecting growing practitioner awareness of potential quality-filtering signals. The discussion is relevant for enterprise content teams assessing algorithmic risk from scaled AI content production.
